objective: Qualify transporter-aware action-value sufficiency separately from scalar Q-V and full Q-F for the phase-factored component-parity candidate.
frozen_candidate: post-RFG component-type multiplicity parity + current rank mod 3 + direct T2 W/L2/O
frozen_component_definition: post-RFG residual-incidence connected components with support/owner-labelled canonical component type and canonical per-column action roles
action_semantics: For each legal action, compare the canonical parent-component action role paired with the exact scalar value of the resulting child. Equality is multiset equality, so duplicate equivalent actions remain semantically visible.
controls: component parity + T2 without rank-mod-3 phase
anti_circularity: Structural keys and action roles are frozen before exact values are derived.
Exact child values are used only as the Q-A qualification target.
No action-value label is used to define the representation or component type.
Direct T2 semantics were independently qualified by EW-RS-022.
falsifiers: Any mixed transporter-aware action-value signature inside the phase-factored key rejects Q-A even if Q-V remains exact.
A Q-A pass supports only the tested finite carriers and does not establish Q-F or standard-7x6 sufficiency.
